This [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''walking plants''' were grown in soil and used as [[Slavery/Legends|laborers]] by the corrupt [[Mining/Legends|miner]] [[Torkil Mux/Legends|Torkil Mux]].

==Characteristics==
This walking [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-like [[Species/Legends|species]] was tall and gray-skinned. They had short, stubby legs and distinguishable heads with ocular organs. According to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], they looked harmless. They were grown in soil and harvested, similar to plants, although they were sentient.

==History==
[[Torkil Mux/Legends|Torkil Mux]] used them to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] gems for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were assigned to deliver a load of plants and soil to [[Shinbone]], where the mine was located. In reality, these were more of the species, planted in the soil. Jabba later revealed they were the last of their kind. Mux had complete control over them, using [[K4 security droid]]s to monitor their actions. When Solo and Chewbacca arrived, they discovered Mux was cheating Jabba. They hatched a plan to rob Mux of his stored gems and his laborers. Chewbacca loaded them onto Mux's [[Torkil Mux's HWK-290 light freighter|ship]] while Solo distracted the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] miner. Chewbacca lifted off, and Solo blasted Mux's droid before escaping in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

The two ships met in orbit. Chewbacca gave the ship to the walking plants and suggested they go to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
